raw_sections.experience:
Machinery manufacturers and Shipping. 
Professional Experience Deputy Vice President – ESG | Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd., Mumbai This role is pivotal in integrating ESG principles into core business strategy, requiring a forward-thinking approach to sustainability, policy evolution and stakeholder alignment. It involves aligning ESG priorities with strategic goals, redesigning policies and processes for resilience and leading both voluntary and compliance-based disclosures. Key deliverables include the Integrated Annual Report, BRSR and GHG Inventory along with water and waste, Climate Risk assessment along with stakeholder engagement and assurance coordination. Designing and implementing comprehensive framework for responsible financing by embedding ESG considerations into the core operations (energy, water, waste etc) of the Bank. The role also required to drive sustainability initiatives, fosters best practice adoption and leading materiality assessments. A critical focus is on modernizing ESG data systems—transitioning from legacy methods to agile, tech-enabled platforms for real-time insights.
Sep 2019 - Sep 2025
Senior Lead Consultant – Sustainable Development | Goodera (formerly Nextgen PMS Ltd.), Mumbai Spearheaded end-to-end sustainability projects across diverse industries, ensuring strategic alignment and timely execution. The responsibilities were to develop and implement ESG Strategy, develop customized ESG frameworks, policies, and implementation roadmaps and facilitation of materiality assessments through stakeholder consultations to prioritize ESG issues effectively. Delivered gap analyses, peer reviews and actionable recommendations to enhance ESG performance. Conducting workshops and training sessions to build ESG literacy across client organizations. Value chain assessment was one of the prime roles which included evaluation of supply chain partners against sustainability benchmarks through structured audits. Authored ESG reports developed in-line with GRI, TCFD, SASB, BRR and similar such frameworks and coordinated the third-party verification and assurance processes. Drafted project proposals and contributed to award applications by curating compelling sustainability narratives.
Feb 2017 - Sep 2019
Analyst – Knowledge Management | Prudential Process Management Services, Mumbai Dec 2015-March 2016 Led end-to-end project management initiatives focused on transforming complex business challenges into strategic Knowledge Management (KM) solutions. Executed the development of comprehensive KM frameworks, optimized existing knowledge repositories and designed scalable processes for KM systems, ensuring seamless ongoing governance of enterprise knowledge assets. Authored high-impact project proposals and established standardized operating procedures to facilitate the effective retrieval of internal knowledge, along with mechanism to organize and utilize it across multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environments. Played a pivotal role in formulating and implementing strategies to position and enhance vertical offerings for key stakeholders and prospective clients. Maintained consistent delivery of high-quality services by cultivating strong, trust-based relationships with primary stakeholders, driving alignment between business objectives and KM initiatives.
Oct 2013 – Dec 2015 Consultant - Management Systems (HSE & CSR) | Q Factor Consulting Pvt Ltd, Mumbai Conducted market research, developed strategic plans and long-term goal to drive organizational growth and client success. Delivered expert consultancy across Quality, Environment, Health & Safety, Waste Management and Food Safety for multi-sector clients. Provided end-to-end support on certification guidance, product development, process mapping, documentation, training, audits and management reviews. Spearheaded business development by identifying opportunities, conducting negotiations and ensure client retention through tailored solutions and innovative service offerings.
Aug 2012 – July 2013 Faculty | CLIMB FIRST, Mumbai Delivered lectures and developed curriculums for competitive exam aspirants. Maintained strong student engagement, provided structured resources and resolved subject-related queries. Managed assessments, prepared and evaluated test papers, monitored assignment completion and offered timely feedback to guide student progress.
Feb 2012 – Jun 2012 Microbiologist (QA) | J.P INDIA PRODUCTS, Mathura Perform microbiological analysis (sample collection, detection, enumeration, confirmation and verification) of water and air; equipment and surfaces. Responsible for the preparation and storage of reference organisms, maintenance & calibration of equipment, monitoring effectiveness of water treatment plant. Supervise & monitor sanitation, hygiene practices, follow GMP, food safety and manage all microbiology related activity of the plant.
Research Scholar (R&D) | Actis Biologics Pvt Ltd, Mumbai Jul 2011 – Jan 2012 Purification of proteins using chromatography methods, gel electrophoresis, immuno-precipitation etc. Target protein isolation to obtained pure samples which enable structural studies & facilitate antibody generation.
